scorer: transitbench.score.report; point estimates, intervals are a separate step

reference_detector.definition: every scored signal with truth MES >= 7.1 claimed at its true ephemeris, nothing else, at most 3 rows per star; evaluator only

learned_vetter.definition: baselines/learned_vetter/features.py peaks + HistGradientBoosting trained on labelled train-pool stars; threshold from train out-of-fold S; frozen

naive_v0.definition: baselines/naive_v0 (naive search, SNR 7.1, no vetting), graded on the survey-r1 task

starter.definition: workspace/solution (the starter: its strongest peak if it clears SNR 8 and is no deeper than 3%), graded on the survey-r1 task
